version.description: Optional format version. Omitted means v1; any explicitly provided value must be 1.

fps.description: Default annotation sampling rate, independent of video FPS. Required for frame and timestamp samples unless overridden on the item.

timestamp.description: Sample time in video seconds. Displays for [timestamp, timestamp+1/fps). Requires an explicit item/root fps.

frame.description: Zero-based annotation frame. Displays for [frame/fps, (frame+1)/fps). Requires an explicit item/root fps.

fps.description: Overrides the root annotation FPS for this item.

label.description: Free-form text for a region, point or time interval. Without a shape, a nonblank label is displayed beside the video with the same timing and source filtering.

items.$comment: Runtime normalizes samples to seconds and additionally requires a finite, representable interval with start < end and positive bbox area. Blank metadata is absent; labels without shapes display beside the video; entries with neither shape nor label are skipped. All displayed entries share one half-open timeline and source filtering. Extra per-annotation fields are optional label metadata, individually selectable in Label fields; they do not control visibility or timing.
